name: dsh-drop-file-to-path
description: Codex-style drag-drop for DSH web GUI: drag any file, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path lands in the composer as a whole blue chip (the mandatory .b64 suffix is display-hidden; the real path serializes on submit). Hot-pluggable: install with `dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/drop-file-to-path`, no dsh source changes.
